show.description: A miracle drug that can cure the deadliest disease or a dangerous lie? Lakshya, a brilliant healer, becomes the face of a medical revolution but behind the success lies a shocking secret. Bound by a ruthless contract, he sacrifices his own blood to save Manya, the very woman who humiliates him. As his freedom nears, power, betrayal, and hidden truths collide, will he finally break free, or lose everything?
